  • Field Details

    • id

      private Long id
      Unique identifier for this user or bot.

    • isBot

      @SerializedName("is_bot") private Boolean isBot
      True, if this user is a bot

    • firstName

      @SerializedName("first_name") private String firstName
      User's or bot's first name

    • lastName

      @SerializedName("last_name") private String lastName
      Optional. User's or bot's last name

    • languageCode

      @SerializedName("language_code") private String languageCode
      Optional. IETF language tag of the user's language

    • username

      private String username
      Optional. User's or bot's username

    • isPremium

      @SerializedName("is_premium") private Boolean isPremium
      Optional. True, if this user is a Telegram Premium user

    • addedToAttachmentMenu

      @SerializedName("added_to_attachment_menu") private Boolean addedToAttachmentMenu
      Optional. True, if this user added the bot to the attachment menu

    • canJoinGroups

      @SerializedName("can_join_groups") private Boolean canJoinGroups
      Optional. True, if the bot can be invited to groups. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().

    • canReadAllGroupMessages

      @SerializedName("can_read_all_group_messages") private Boolean canReadAllGroupMessages
      Optional. True, if privacy mode is disabled for the bot. Returned only in getMe.

    • supportsInlineQueries

      @SerializedName("supports_inline_queries") private Boolean supportsInlineQueries
      Optional. True, if the bot supports inline queries. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().

    • canConnectToBusiness

      @SerializedName("can_connect_to_business") private Boolean canConnectToBusiness
      Optional. True, if the bot can be connected to a Telegram Business account to receive its messages. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().

    • hasMainWebApp

      @SerializedName("has_main_web_app") private Boolean hasMainWebApp
      Optional. True, if the bot has a main Web App. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().

    • hasTopicsEnabled

      @SerializedName("has_topics_enabled") private Boolean hasTopicsEnabled
      Optional. True, if the bot has forum topic mode enabled in private chats. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().

    • allowsUsersToCreateTopics

      @SerializedName("allows_users_to_create_topics") private Boolean allowsUsersToCreateTopics
      Optional. True, if the bot allows users to create and delete topics in private chats. Returned only in BotContext.getMe().
